about.title: About Germany
about.text: Located in the heart of Europe, Germany boasts one of the world's strongest economies and is renowned for its rich culture and long history, having witnessed numerous civilizations and significant events throughout the ages. Germany is a culturally diverse nation, home to a blend of different ethnicities and nationalities, and is a premier study destination, attracting students from around the globe thanks to its prestigious education system, which includes many world-renowned universities and research institutions. Germany has a sophisticated infrastructure, including an efficient transportation network and high-speed internet access. It is also a safe and stable country with low crime rates and offers excellent economic opportunities for students and graduates, with numerous global companies and innovative research centers. With its breathtaking landscapes, from the majestic Alps to the dense Black Forest, Germany is an ideal tourist destination, offering a wide array of historical, cultural, and natural attractions. Rich in history, culture, and nature, Germany is an ideal destination for studying, working, and living.

items.title: Among the Best Universities in the World
items.text: German universities are among the best in the world, offering high-quality study programs in various fields.

items.title: The Strength of an Academic Degree
items.text: Studying in Germany represents an unparalleled strength in a student's CV, given the internationally recognized degrees and rigorous training students receive. German degrees are recognized in Arab and European countries, and most countries worldwide.

items.title: Programs in English
items.text: Many study programs at German universities are taught in English, making them an ideal destination for international students.

items.title: Learning German
items.text: You can learn and practice German fluently through daily interactions and continuous use in listening, reading, and writing. It is one of the most in-demand languages ​​in today's job market.

items.title: Job Opportunities After Graduation
items.text: Germany does not restrict its academic students after graduation, but rather allows them to gain practical experience in the job market, even during their final years of study.

items.title: Freedom of Travel Within Europe
items.text: A Schengen visa gives you the opportunity to travel freely between approximately 27 European countries, such as France, Italy, Spain, Austria, and Germany, without restrictions.

items.title: Active University Life
items.text: German universities offer a vibrant campus environment, with cultural, social, and sporting activities that help students integrate and connect.

items.title: Encouraging Scientific Research
items.text: Germany is an environment that encourages scientific research and innovation, with ample opportunities for students to participate in research and development projects.

items.title: Strong Infrastructure
items.text: Germany boasts a strong and continuously improving infrastructure, including transportation networks, electricity, gas, sewage systems, and renewable energy.

items.title: High Level of Safety
items.text: Germany is a very safe country, with low rates of violence and theft, advanced emergency services and hospitals, and a strong police presence.

items.title: Comprehensive Health Insurance
items.text: Students in Germany receive comprehensive health insurance that guarantees high-quality healthcare throughout their studies.

educationSystem.title: Education System in Germany
educationSystem.text: The education system in Germany is considered one of the best education systems in the world.
points: Compulsory education: from the age of six to eighteen, divided into primary school, lower secondary school, and upper secondary school.
Compulsory vocational education for a duration of two years.

Optional education (upper secondary level): this stage allows students to choose the type of school that suits them, including specialized secondary schools for girls (home economics), schools focused on economics and business administration, and vocational and technical schools offering programs in engineering, technology, economics, and agriculture.
University level: Germany offers more than 20,000 bachelor's degree programs to meet labor market needs and help students achieve their academic ambitions.

costs.title: Study Costs in German Universities
costs.text: Studying in Germany is relatively affordable compared to other European countries.
list: Public universities charge small semester fees ranging between €150 and €250.
Tuition fees at private universities in Germany start from 6,000 euros per year and go up to 20,000 euros per year for a bachelor's degree.
Living costs are moderate compared to Western European countries.

housing.title: Types of Student Accommodation in Germany
housing.text: Before seeking admission to Germany, collecting application forms, and choosing a major, it's essential to thoroughly research suitable accommodation options. Do you prefer living near or far from the university? Do you prefer private or shared accommodation? Here are the most common types of student accommodation in Germany:

types.title: University Accommodation
points: This is the most popular option among international students due to its affordability.
It provides a suitable study environment and proximity to the campus.
Early application is required due to the high demand for this type of accommodation.

types.title: Student Housing
types.text: Students resort to this when university housing is unavailable or uncomfortable. Students choose a single room or a shared room with another student, and can search for it through social media or student unions.

types.title: Private Housing
types.text: Suitable for students who want more privacy and comfort, as they can rent a private apartment with greater freedom and independence, but it is the most expensive option.

types.title: Living with a family
types.text: One of the best options in terms of cost, and it also helps students learn and practice German daily. This type requires flexibility and mutual understanding between the student and the host family to ensure a comfortable experience.

requirements.title: Admission Requirements for German Universities
items: A preparatory year in German for some study programs.
Proof of English or German language proficiency (usually B2 level).
Passing admission exams such as TestAS, DSH, or APS.
Proof of financial ability (blocked bank account or scholarship).

items.title: Learn About German Culture
items.text: Punctuality and organization are core values in German society.

items.title: Learn Basic German
items.text: Even if you study in English, German is essential for daily life.

items.title: Health Insurance
items.text: Make sure your health insurance documents are ready before traveling.

items.title: Prepare for the Weather
items.text: Bring suitable clothing for cold weather, especially during winter.
